timeline.text_cn: 摩擦供能——主要威能 获得能量上限从50点提升至75点。
获得能量上限从50点提升至75点。
充能射击最大基础伤害从120点降低至115点。
原效果：[充能射击]造成最后一击时触发一次爆炸，伤害量为该次[充能射击]伤害量的75%。新效果：完整充能的[充能射击]或[充能射击]暴击时触发一次爆炸，对周围的其他敌人造成50%伤害。
现在会缩短所有技能的冷却时间，而不仅是“干扰弹”的冷却时间。
原效果：[电磁炮]充能产生量提高25%。[电磁炮]充能衰减速度减慢75%。新效果：[机动滑铲]及后续跳跃持续期间，每秒获得10%[电磁炮]充能并恢复50%最大弹药。[电磁炮]充能衰减速度减慢75%。
+50%[机动滑铲]速度。[机动滑铲]持续期间，获得25%受伤减免，并对周围敌人造成75点伤害。
[机动滑铲]及后续跳跃持续期间，[充能射击]弹道尺寸扩大50%，攻击速度加快35%，武器生命汲取提高35%。
现在会提供充能，数值等于技能伤害的50%，而不只是[干扰弹]伤害。
原效果：[机动滑铲]持续期间获得35%受伤减免。[机动滑铲]持续时间延长100%。新效果：[机动滑铲]持续时间延长1秒。造成消灭会重置[机动滑铲]的冷却时间。
原效果：[机动滑铲]持续期间，获得35%攻击速度和100%武器生命汲取。新效果：[机动滑铲]获得一次额外充能。
电荷转换器——史诗技能英雄物品
每消耗1点[电磁炮]充能，[充能射击]获得0.25%技能强度，持续3秒，最多40%。
超频电涌——史诗技能英雄物品
[机体超频]激活时，技能刷新速度加快300%。在[机体超频]持续期间消灭敌人会使其持续时间延长2秒。
后燃器——稀有生存英雄物品
添加效果：25%[机动滑铲]长度。
移除效果：5%冷却时间缩减。
火箭动力标枪——史诗生存英雄物品
额外近身攻击伤害从30%提高至100%。

timeline.text_en: Friction Generators – Major Perk Max energy gained increased from 50 to 75.
Max energy gained increased from 50 to 75.
Charged Shot Max base damage reduced to 115 (Down from 120).

Reworked from "[Charged Shot] Final Blows trigger an explosion for 75% of the damage dealt" to "Fully-charged [Charged Shot] or [Charged Shot] critical hits trigger an explosion, dealing 50% damage to other nearby enemies".
Now reduces cooldowns of all abilities instead of just Disruptor Shot.

Reworked from "Generate 25% more Railgun charge. Railgun charge decays 75% slower" to "During [Power Slide] and the jump after, gain 10% [Railgun] Charge and restore 50% of your Max Ammo every 1s. [Railgun] Charge decays 75% slower".
"+50% [Power Slide] Speed. During [Power Slide], gain 25% damage reduction and deal 75 damage to nearby enemies."
"During [Power Slide] and the jump after, gain 50% [Charged Shot] projectile size, 35% Attack Speed, and 35% Weapon Lifesteal."
Now grants Charge equal to 50% of Ability Damage instead of just Disruptor Shot damage.
Reworked from "Gain 35% Damage Reduction during [Power Slide]. [Power Slide] has 100% increased duration" to "+1s [Power Slide] Duration. Eliminations reset [Power Slide] cooldown".
Reworked from 'During [Powerslide], gain 35% Attack Speed and 100% Weapon Lifesteal" to "Gain an additional [Power Slide] charge".
Charge Convertor - Epic Hero Ability Item
"[Charged Shot] grants 0.25% Ability Power for every 1 [Railgun] Charge spent for 3s, up to 40%."
Overclocked Surge - Epic Hero Ability Item
"While [Overclock] is active, abilities refresh 300% faster. Eliminations during [Overclock] increase its duration by 2s."
Rocket Powered Javelin - Epic Hero Survival Item
Bonus Melee Damage increased to 100% (Up from 30%).
Energized Power Slide moves 100% faster and trips enemies Sojourn collides with.
Energized Disruptor Shot leaves behind 2 smaller energy bursts as it travels.
The smaller energy bursts have a 2-meter radius and deal 60 damage per second.
While at 100 energy, Sojourn's abilities consume 50 energy to become energized.

timeline.text_cn: 充能的机动滑铲移动速度加快100%，并绊倒被“索杰恩”碰到的敌人。
充能的干扰弹在飞行时会留下2次小型能量迸发。
小型能量迸发半径2米，每秒造成60点伤害。
达到100能量时，“索杰恩”的技能会消耗50能量充能。

timeline.text_cn: 已加入角斗领域英雄阵容。
“电磁炮”最大充能提高至150%。完全充能的攻击和技能仍然消耗最多100%充能。
发射完全充能的“充能射击”后，“充能射击”的弹道尺寸增大25%，持续4秒（可叠加3次）。
“电磁炮”充能产生量提高25%。“电磁炮”充能衰减速度减慢75%。
“充能射击”会返还“干扰弹”的冷却时间，消耗的充能越多，返还的冷却时间越多，最多35%。
“充能射击”造成最后一击时触发一次爆炸，伤害量为该次“充能射击”伤害量的75%。
“干扰弹”可以附着在敌人身上。附着的“干扰弹”造成的伤害降低50%。
“干扰弹”使效果范围内的敌人减速15%，并获得“电磁炮”充能，数值为“干扰弹”伤害量的33%。
“火箭发射器”直接命中会使燃料上限提高2点，可叠加25次。
“机动滑铲”持续期间，获得25%受伤减免。“机动滑铲”持续时间延长100%。
“机动滑铲”在滑铲启动和跳跃时生成一发迷你“干扰弹”。
“机动滑铲”持续期间，“电磁炮”不消耗弹药且每秒恢复弹药，数值为最大弹药的50%。
“机体超频”持续期间，“电磁炮”主要攻击模式会自动锁定敌人。
意式咖啡弹——稀有武器英雄物品
在“机体超频”持续期间消灭敌人会使其持续时间延长2秒。
火箭动力标枪——稀有武器英雄物品
“机动滑铲”持续期间，快速近身攻击命中敌人会将其击退，且造成的伤害提高30%。
墨菲的电机模块——史诗武器英雄物品
造成消灭会重置“机动滑铲”的冷却时间。
沙赫玛特棋的谋略——史诗武器英雄物品
在消耗“电磁炮”充能后，提高“电磁炮”的弹道速度，数值为消耗的“电磁炮”充能的50%，持续3秒。
能量吸取——稀有技能英雄物品
“干扰弹”造成消灭会提供10%终极技能充能。
加拿大武装部队校准器——稀有技能英雄物品
廖的后勤数据——史诗技能英雄物品
后燃器——史诗生存英雄物品

timeline.text_en: Added to the Stadium Hero roster.
Max Railgun Charge increased to 150%. Fully-charged attacks and abilities still only consume up to 100% charge.
After using a fully-charged Charged Shot, gain 25% increased Charged Shot projectile size for 4s (stacking up to 3 times).
Generate 25% more Railgun charge. Railgun charge decays 75% slower.
Charged Shot refunds up to 35% of Disruptor Shot's cooldown, based on the Charge spent.
Charged Shot Final Blows trigger an explosion for 75% of the damage dealt.
Disruptor Shot can stick to enemies. Stuck Disruptor Shots deal 50% less damage.
Disruptor Shot slows enemies within its area for 15% and grants 33% of its damage dealt as Railgun Charge.
Gain 25% Damage Reduction during Power Slide. Power Slide duration increased by 100%.
Power Slide spawns a mini Disruptor Shot when activated and when you jump.
During Power Slide, Railgun does not consume ammo and restores 50% of your Max Ammo every second.
During Overclock, Railgun Primary Fire automatically targets enemies.
Espresso Shots - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Eliminations during Overclock increase its duration by 2s.
Rocket-Powered Javelin - Rare Weapon Hero Item
Quick Melee hits during Power Slide knock enemies back and deal 30% increased damage.
Murphy's Motor Module - Epic Weapon Hero Item
Shah-Mat Strategem - Epic Weapon Hero item
After spending Railgun Charge, gain Railgun Projectile Speed equal to 50% the Railgun Charge spent for 3s.
Energy Leech - Rare Ability Hero Item
Disruptor Shot eliminations grant 10% Ultimate Charge.
CAF Calibrator- Rare Ability Hero Item
Liao's Logistics Data - Epic Ability Hero Item
